answer.submission_route: The denial notice supplied does not state an appeal mailing address, fax number, portal, or other submission address. If those instructions are absent, contact Anthem Member Services at the telephone number on the back of the ID card and ask for the exact submission address or fax number for a medical-necessity appeal, identifying reference number POC-3A74C3E137-54728. Include the member name and ID, the denied CPT 27130 request, the denial notice, and supporting clinical records.

The publicly posted Carelon guideline also states that copies are available upon oral or written request. Ask specifically whether Anthem used Carelon guideline MSK02-1125.1, an Anthem medical policy, or proprietary MCG criteria.
